baseline: Planned Flash-1017, TP1 DP4 EP4, MegaMoE, DSpark5. Source defaults; live image not verified.
statement: Localize routed and fused-shared MXFP4/FP8 MegaMoE weights across physical GPU memory domains, using the existing domain-aware scheduler, to test lower decode MoE cost without changing routing or quantization.
mechanism: Physical placement aligns weight slices with persistent CTAs already assigned by the dependency to locality domains; reduced remote traffic/power may reduce weight-read cost. Whether that is on the critical decode path is unmeasured.
proposed_change: Post-load, before EPLB view/NIXL registration and graph capture, localize already transformed routed L1/L2 and fused shared L1/L2 weights. Keep scale layout. Export each routed domain slice as a separate contiguous (E,-1) EPLB component; preserve reload ownership and prohibit stale pre-localization views. Do not disable baseline EPLB.

supportsource.exact_short_quote: optional weight localization and domain-aware scheduling

pincheck.delta: Physical weight localization absent in target _register_weight torch.zeros; dependency already supports MXFP4 localized layouts and already invokes locality mapping in ordinary launch. Not a dependency upgrade/scheduler-addition claim.
callchain: DeepGEMM csrc/apis/mega_moe.hpp:logical layout checks, shared parity, architecture major10 dispatch
pincheck.source_shape: ordinary routed (E,N,Kpacked) becomes (2,E,N/2,Kpacked); each domain slice is the candidate EPLB component
pincheck.eligibility: MXFP4 path and architecture-major10 source dispatch. Actual driver/MPS/tooling/locality map unknown; no claim from hardcoded domain count or sm100 filename. Separate NVFP4 path not covered.

priorcomparison: Distinct from M01 route-histogram tile choices, N03 SM quota/Weave, inter-GPU EPLB placements, expert offload and AT03 compressed-KV reuse. Existing scheduler is explicitly excluded from new delta.
counterevidence: No target ITL measurement; upstream power/frequency claim is not token throughput.
Naive Parameter replacement breaks expert-leading loader/EPLB shape; naive flatten mixes experts. Domain-slice repair passes only shape/symbolic test.
Shared and routed localization must match; scales remain ordinary.
Availability helper starts CUDA/MPS; even cleanup can probe GPU. None executed.
Probe may fall back to even mapping; successful allocation does not prove useful affinity.
Requires full GPU SM count; do not combine blindly with SM partition proposals.
Temporary allocation/copy and padding need measured HBM headroom; retaining both full representations is not acceptable by default.
Live checkpoint expert format, installed dependency revision, MPS eligibility and baseline EPLB not yet audited.

CPUcheck.result: Extracted target EPLB view accepts ordinary and domain-slice shapes; rejects domain-first whole tensors for two target packed matrices. Symbolic swap of all domain components reconstructs desired expert; naive flatten fails.
CPUcheck.limits: Shape-only stubs and symbolic coordinates, not torch stride/allocation, distributed copy, loader lifecycle, numerical inference or speed.

evalplan.now: Read saved loader/EPLB registration call order and define no-stale-view conversion point. CPU adapter tests should reconstruct packed weights/scales after simulated remote and duplicate expert transfers. No device allocator calls.
evalplan.future_authorized: First attest actual MLOPart availability and mapping quality on an idle isolated node; verify physical tensor allocation, round-trip packed weights, outputs, EPLB transitions and stable captured pointers. Then paired same-route/shape MegaMoE timing followed by standard Mooncake and agent-75 A/B under unchanged DSpark and full workload.
evalplan.existing_evaluator_coverage: Both serving workloads can expose decode ITL/TPOT, throughput, TTFT/tail regressions; use request-level paired repeats and identical output lengths. Neither alone proves locality or diagnoses clock/power causes.
evalplan.additional_only_for_missing_mechanism: Targeted weight-layout/EPLB correctness and mapping/power/clock/MoE-duration instrumentation, not another replacement workload.
evalplan.gain_estimation: Unknown. Amdahl bound requires observed exposed MoE fraction; do not multiply upstream clock improvement by end-to-end latency.

baseline: Planned Flash-1017, TP1 DP4 EP4, MegaMoE, DSpark5. Source defaults; live image not verified.
statement: Cache repeat MXFP8 CuTeDSL host runner construction and successful metadata validation on genuinely uncaptured decode calls.
mechanism: Avoid repeated Python factory/validation overhead without caching outputs or skipping launches.
proposed_change: Adapt donor cache keyed by all tensor shapes/strides/dtypes/devices plus output dtype and scale layout, only after demonstrating uncaptured host exposure and compatible FlashInfer API.

pincheck.delta: Target FlashInferCutedslMxfp8LinearKernel apply_weights calls vllm.utils.flashinfer.mm_mxfp8, which forwards raw API with out=None. No equivalent caching seen in this wrapper; installed FlashInfer internals could already cache.
pincheck.eligibility: CuTeDSL backend, compatible private runner factory, donor guard FlashInfer>=0.7.0; actual backend/image unverified.

priorcomparison: Specific host wrapper cache, not GPU kernel fusion or shared FlashMLA planner. Still shares broad host-overhead premise with prior host-control work; no new service claim without exposed path.
counterevidence: CUDA graph replay does not re-run this host validation/factory each step.
Donor body has no filled speed/accuracy report; tests prove cache behavior, not serving win.
Target installed FlashInfer may already cache internals.
Private API and omitted metadata keys could produce stale specialization; backend/version gating required.

CPUcheck.reason: Do not mirror donor cache tests before exposure is established; source graph boundary is the cheaper discriminator.

evalplan.now: Audit saved graph mode and actual selected FlashInfer version/backend; determine whether call occurs during capture only or during each decode replay. Reject if capture-only.
evalplan.future_authorized: If exposed, compare host factory/validation counts and CPU wall time, then same standard Mooncake/agent-75 streaming ITL and tail guards.
evalplan.gain_estimation: Unknown; no duration attributable to repeated host calls yet.
